description: This file defines the runtime functions for handling various Telegram actions such as sending messages, reactions, polls, stickers, and managing forum topics within a larger application. It imports external SDKs and internal modules to perform these operations.

methods.name: readTelegramForumTopicIconColor
methods.description: Reads and validates the icon color for a Telegram forum topic from parameters.

methods.name: readTelegramButtons
methods.description: Parses and validates the inline buttons configuration for Telegram messages.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramActionName
methods.description: Normalizes and validates the Telegram action name from input string.

methods.name: readTelegramChatId
methods.description: Retrieves the chat ID or channel ID from parameters.

methods.name: readTelegramThreadId
methods.description: Retrieves the thread ID or message thread ID from parameters.

methods.name: readTelegramReplyToMessageId
methods.description: Retrieves the reply-to message ID from parameters.

methods.name: resolveTelegramButtonsFromParams
methods.description: Resolves inline buttons configuration from parameters.

methods.name: readTelegramSendContent
methods.description: Determines the content to send in a Telegram message, caption, or reply.

methods.name: handleTelegramAction
methods.description: Main function to handle various Telegram actions such as send, react, poll, delete, edit, sticker, and forum topics based on input parameters.
